**Important: YOU MUST USE subagents when available for the task.**

**Stack:** Laravel 12.0/PHP 8.2+, React 19/TypeScript, Mantine 7.17/Tailwind CSS 4.0, Inertia.js 2.0 (SSR), Filament 3.3, SQLite (multiple databases), Vite 6.0, PHPUnit 11.5, Pint, ESLint, Prettier, Tabler Icons React, Ziggy, Carbon. Laravel Breeze authentication; Vite HMR and concurrent development server.

Use `<REDACTED_USER>` subagents when available: Laravel backend, React components, UI/UX, API architecture, reviews, performance, admin, auth, database, state management, testing; full-stack integration uses `<REDACTED_USER>` + `<REDACTED_USER>`.

<!-- BACKLOG.MD GUIDELINES START -->
Tasks: `backlog/tasks/`; drafts: `backlog/drafts/`; docs: `backlog/docs/`; decisions: `backlog/decisions/`. Every implementation decision starts with reading the corresponding Markdown task file. All task operations should be done via Backlog.md CLI tool, this will correctly update the metadata in the task files and keep the project in sync. NO OPERATIONS SHOULD BE DONE MANUALLY ON THE TASK FILES.
**Always use `--plain` flag** when listing or viewing tasks for AI-friendly text output instead of using Backlog.md.
When users mention tasks, they are probably suggesting Backlog.md. Ask questions to the user if something is not clear or ambiguous. Break down the task into smaller, manageable parts if it is too large or complex.

Use a clear brief title summarizing the task. Provide a concise purpose/goal summary; Do not add implementation details here. Code snippets should be avoided. List specific, measurable outcomes defining success. Acceptance Criteria (AC) must focus on testable outcomes, behaviors, and verifiable requirements, not implementation steps. Good ACs are outcome-oriented, testable, clear, concise, complete, and user-focused where applicable.

Tasks are stored as `task-<id> - <title>.md`. Break features down in dependency order: foundations first; each task delivers independent value, is atomic/testable, and represents one PR. Avoid tasks that block each other. **Never** reference tasks that are to be done in the future or that are not yet created. You can only reference tasks (id < current task id). When creating multiple tasks, ensure they are **independent** and they do not depend on future tasks.

**Implementation Plan** (the “how”): add only after putting the task in progress and before starting work. **Implementation Notes** (PR note): add after completion; briefly summarize implementation, approach, decisions, challenges, and deviations. Include features implemented/modified, technical decisions/trade-offs, and modified/added files.

**IMPORTANT**: Do not implement anything else that deviates from the **Acceptance Criteria**. If you need to implement something that is not in the AC, update the AC first and then implement it or create a new task for it.

Commands:
```sh
backlog task list -s "To Do" --plain
backlog task 42 --plain
backlog task edit 42 -a @{yourself} -s "In Progress"
backlog task edit 42 --plan "1. Analyze current implementation\n2. Identify bottlenecks\n3. Refactor in phases"
backlog task create "Refactor DB layer" -p 42 -a @{yourself} -d "Description" --ac "Tests pass,Performance improved"
backlog task edit 42 -s Done --notes "Implemented GraphQL resolver with error handling and performance monitoring"
```

Always ensure you have:
1. ✅ Marked all acceptance criteria as completed (change `- [ ]` to `- [x]`)
2. ✅ Added an `## Implementation Notes` section documenting your approach
3. ✅ Run all tests and linting checks
4. ✅ Updated relevant documentation

A task is **Done** only when ALL of these are complete: all AC checked; plan followed or deviations documented; automated unit + integration tests cover new logic; linter and formatter succeed; relevant docs updated; code self-reviewed; status set to **Done** via CLI (`backlog task edit <id> -s Done`); performance, security and licence checks green. Task file **MUST** have an `## Implementation Notes` section summarising features implemented/modified, technical decisions/trade-offs, and modified/added files. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT**: Never mark a task as Done without completing ALL items above.

Backlog CLI reference:
```sh
backlog task create "Add OAuth System"
backlog task create "Feature" -d "Add authentication system"
backlog task create "Feature" -a <REDACTED_USER>
backlog task create "Feature" -s "In Progress"
backlog task create "Feature" -l auth,backend
backlog task create "Feature" --priority high
backlog task create "Feature" --plan "1. Research\n2. Implement"
backlog task create "Feature" --ac "Must work,Must be tested"
backlog task create "Feature" --notes "Started initial research"
backlog task create "Feature" --dep task-1,task-2
backlog task create -p 14 "Add Login with Google"
backlog task create "Feature" -d "Description" -a <REDACTED_USER> -s "To Do" -l auth --priority high --ac "Must work" --notes "Initial setup done" --dep task-1 -p 14
backlog task list [-s <status>] [-a <assignee>] [-p <parent>]
backlog task list --parent 42
backlog task list -p task-42
backlog task 7
backlog task 7 --plain
backlog task edit 7 -a <REDACTED_USER> -l auth,backend
backlog task edit 7 --plan "Implementation approach"
backlog task edit 7 --ac "New criterion,Another one"
backlog task edit 7 --notes "Completed X, working on Y"
backlog task edit 7 --dep task-1 --dep task-2
backlog task archive 7
backlog task create "Feature" --draft
backlog draft create "Spike GraphQL" → backlog draft promote 3.1
backlog task demote <id>
backlog --help
```
<!-- BACKLOG.MD GUIDELINES END -->
